'''I5-T1''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] that was part of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] forces during the [[Korriban Incursion]], when the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] invaded the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]<ref name="TOR" /> in [[3637 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> during the [[Galactic War]]. I5-T1 was tasked with guarding the force field erected in the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]] next to the [[Tomb of Ajunta Pall]], but was destroyed by Republic forces in their push to the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
I5-T1 appears as the second boss in the Republic version of the Tactical Flashpoint "Assault on Tython," which was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' in Game Update 2.7: Invasion. For Imperial players, I5-T1 is replaced by [[R-9XR]], and the two are virtually identical in terms of their game mechanics.<ref name="TOR" />
